problem: Consider the subsets $\; \begin{gathered}A=\left\{\begin{gathered} \langle x, y, z \rangle \in \mathbb{R}^3 :\\ x^2=y \end{gathered}\right\}\end{gathered}\;$ and $\; \begin{gathered}B=\\\left\{\begin{gathered} \langle 3-t, -3+t, -6+2t \rangle :\\ t \in \mathbb{R} \end{gathered}\right\}\end{gathered}.\;$ Which of them is a subspace of $\mathbb{R}^3?$
